project_inclusion.range_basis: Current Kew treatment excludes Texas from native range; retain FAIL_TARGET_ZONE and treat Texas encounters as planted/escaped unless verified otherwise.

look_here_first: Look for tall clonal stems with broad opposite leaves, then dense rounded axillary umbels and individual five-hooded flowers; do not use pink color alone.

best_field_traits: tall rhizomatous perennial with milky latex
broad opposite elliptic-ovate leaves, often pale and hairy beneath
inflated follicles often with soft tubercles

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. speciosa often has larger more star-like individual flowers and visibly woolly stems; corona detail is safer than flower color. A. incarnata has much narrower leaves and wet-site ecology.
